note: NECO Civic round 5 (R30 top-up): bill readings, committee stage, public hearing, assent, two-thirds override, recall; petition tribunals, party registration spread, Boundary Commission; federal character, unity-school quota, national consciousness; flag's green, eagle, Niger-Benue bands, NYSC 1973, FRSC; EFCC vs ICPC mandates, Code of Conduct; tax and obedience duties, vigilance, voting; representative lawmaking, secret ballot, majority tyranny, emergency limits; accountability, constructive criticism, lawful followership, community participation, mediation of land quarrels, apathy as the enemy. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC Civic (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
